topic: 99% of Global Internet is on the Ocean Floor
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

99% of the internet is not in the sky... it is sitting on the ocean floor!

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Over 500 undersea fiber optic cables carry global data.
🔹 They transmit data at 99.7% the speed of light.
🔹 Deep-sea cables are only as thick as a garden hose, but carry trillions of dollars daily!
